title: SkipCat: Rank-Maximized Low-Rank Compression of Large Language Models via Shared Projection and Block Skipping
abstract: arXiv:2512.13494v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLM) have achieved remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks. However, their substantial parameter sizes pose significant challenges for deployment on edge devices with limited computational and memory resources. Low-rank compression is a promising approach to address this issue, as it reduces both computational and memory costs, making LLM more suitable for resource-constrained environments. Nonetheless, na\"ive low-rank compression methods require a significant reduction in the retained rank to achieve meaningful memory and computation savings. For a low-rank model, the ranks need to be reduced by more than half to yield efficiency gains. Such aggressive truncation, however, typically results in substantial performance degradation. To address this trade-off, we propose SkipCat, a novel low-rank compression framework that enables the use of higher ranks while achieving the same compression rate

translated_title: SkipCat：通过共享投影与块跳过实现大语言模型的秩最大化低秩压缩
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在广泛的任务中取得了卓越的性能。然而，其庞大的参数规模为其在计算和内存资源有限的边缘设备上的部署带来了重大挑战。低秩压缩是解决这一问题的一种有前景的方法，因为它能够同时降低计算和内存成本，使大语言模型更适合资源受限的环境。然而，朴素的低秩压缩方法需要大幅削减所保留的秩才能实现有意义的内存和计算节省。对于一个低秩模型，秩需要减少一半以上才能带来效率提升。然而，如此激进的截断通常会导致显著的性能下降。为了解决这一权衡问题，我们提出了SkipCat，一种新颖的低秩压缩框架，它能够在实现相同压缩率的同时使用更高的秩。
tldr: SkipCat是一种新颖的大语言模型低秩压缩框架，通过共享投影和块跳过机制，在相同压缩率下保留更高的秩，从而避免了传统低秩压缩中因秩过度削减而导致的显著性能下降。
en_tdlr: SkipCat is a novel low-rank compression framework for LLMs that leverages shared projection and block skipping to enable higher ranks at the same compression rate, thereby avoiding the substantial performance degradation caused by aggressive rank truncation in conventional low-rank compression.
